gloss: first half of the year; first half of the fiscal year

definitions.gloss: first half of the year; first half of the fiscal year
definitions.explanation: The first six months of a calendar year or fiscal year. In the Japanese fiscal year (April to March), the first half runs from April to September.

examples.japanese: {上半期|かみはんき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{売|う}り{上|あ}げ⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{好調|こうちょう}→好調：12209_kouchou⟧だった。
examples.english: Sales in the first half of the year were strong.

examples.japanese: {上半期|かみはんき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{決算|けっさん}{報告|ほうこく}→決算報告：25816_kessanhoukoku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦まとめている→まとめる：02424_matomeru⟧。
examples.english: I am compiling the financial report for the first half.

examples.japanese: {上半期|かみはんき}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{赤字|あかじ}→赤字：04712_akaji⟧だった⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{下半期|しもはんき}→下半期：19925_shimohanki⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{巻|ま}き{返|かえ}す→巻き返す：07006_makikaesu⟧⟦{計画|けいかく}→計画：01172_keikaku⟧だ。
examples.english: We were in the red in the first half, but we plan to make a comeback in the second half.

notes:
Composed of {上|かみ} (upper, first) + {半期|はんき} (half-period). Primarily used in business and economic contexts. In Japan, the fiscal year runs from April to March, so {上半期|かみはんき} typically refers to April through September.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {上半期|かみはんき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{業績|ぎょうせき}→業績：04873_gyouseki⟧: first-half performance
- {上半期|かみはんき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{決算|けっさん}→決算：05973_kessan⟧: first-half financial results
- {上半期|かみはんき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{売|う}り{上|あ}げ: first-half sales
- {上半期|かみはんき}⟦{中|ちゅう}→〜中：09840_chuu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: during the first half

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{下半期|しもはんき}→下半期：19925_shimohanki⟧: second half of the year — the direct counterpart
- ⟦{前半|ぜんはん}→前半：11875_zenhan⟧: first half — more general, used for any time period or event
- ⟦{四半期|しはんき}→四半期：10103_shihanki⟧: quarter (of a year) — a finer division used in business reporting
